about: Three moments of one simulated day in the home ADA-010, in real time. For each activity of the day a language model was told the state and wrote its reasoning and three options with a chance for each. Each moment is then a loop: before every small step the model is given an observation (only what the person can perceive from where they stand, by seeing and hearing rules we assumed) and the one-line note it wrote at the step before, and writes a thought, three options with chances and a new note. The simulator draws one (more sharply the more pressing the most unmet need), adds this person's slips at assumed rates, and keeps the clock, the walking and the needs. Recorded runs, replayed.
character: slightly fond of food, moderately quick to tire, quite sociable, moderately house-proud, moderately easily bored, slightly particular about washing, moderately fond of comfort.
